{{Quote|If we can't have it, no one can.|The Ossiki Confederacy's leader, on access to food|<ref name="Characters" />}}
The '''Ossiki Confederacy''' was an organization on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]]<ref name="Characters" /> in the intersection of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> It was one of several confederacies that fought over resources during the [[Toydarian seasonal wars]]. The [[Ossiki's leader|leader]] of the Confederacy declared that stockpiles of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] should be destroyed if the Confederacy could not claim it. As a result,<ref name="Characters" /> the [[Ossiki Confederacy Army]] became infamous for the use of chemical [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] to destroy food supplies.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|427|Ossiki Confederacy Army}}</ref> The [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] joined the Ossiki Confederacy Army during a war caused by drought. He was injured in the conflict<ref name="Characters" /> and by approximately [[38 BBY/Legends|38 BBY]],<ref name="Watto date">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']] states that [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] was present on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] not long after [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] arrived there when he was roughly three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old. The book also states that Skywalker was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]]. Therefore, Watto must have left the [[Ossiki Confederacy Army]] by approximately [[38 BBY/Legends|38 BBY]].</ref> had left the [[Army/Legends|army]] after the war ended.<ref name="Characters" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ossiki Confederacy was first mentioned within the name of the Ossiki Confederacy Army in Watto's [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry on [[StarWars.com]], published in [[2001]].<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|watto|Watto}}</ref> It was first specified to be a separate entity in the [[2002]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="Characters" />
